title.quote: PhotoBot: Reference-Guided Interactive Photography via Natural Language
title.justification: The title is stated at the beginning of the paper.
title.value: PhotoBot: Reference-Guided Interactive Photography via Natural Language

extractions.description: Introduces and experimentally evaluates PhotoBot, an interactive robotic-photography framework that retrieves reference images with pretrained vision/language models and aligns an RGB-D camera to them using semantic correspondences and PnP-based view adjustment.

type.quote: We conducted experiments demonstrating that the photos taken by PhotoBot are aesthetically pleasing, address the users’ prompts, and follow the reference images’ layouts and compositions.
type.justification: The work implements a system and evaluates it through robot experiments, user studies, and controlled ablations.

name.quote: Much of the prior research in the area of robotic photography

name.quote: In our work, we are also interested in user interactivity.
name.justification: Natural-language interaction between a human subject and a robot photographer is a central contribution.

name.quote: an experimental analysis of the perspective-n-point (PnP) problem with learned semantic-level keypoint correspondences across widely different scenes
name.justification: The paper advances a computer-vision approach for semantic correspondence and camera pose/view alignment.

name.quote: a language-guided assistant that provides photography suggestions based on high-level human guidance
name.justification: Natural-language guidance and LLM reasoning are used to support the contributed interactive system.

name.quote: We demonstrate our approach using a manipulator equipped with a wrist camera.
name.justification: Robotics provides the physical platform and control setting for the system.
